comment.text: BRD4 P1065 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: esophagusstomach; Skin tumors; Gastric tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.
